summary: Building the AI and platform infrastructure behind an omnichannel commerce product.
highlights: Architected a high-throughput AI chat billing and credit system using Redis for fast balance checks, Kafka for event streaming, and ClickHouse as an append-only audit ledger — achieving p99 latency of 40ms at 1,500 RPS with 100% transactional correctness.

Conducted a comprehensive API Gateway evaluation across multiple criteria (latency, observability, extensibility, architectural fit, and compatibility), delivering a formal recommendation adopted by engineering leadership.
Engineered a Go-based API Gateway that handled ~20k+ daily requests with an SLA of 99.86%.

Engineered a distributed task queue with Go and RabbitMQ, progress tracking with Redis, and a job management system powering an AI-based product-matching pipeline — processing ~11K product records per run with reliable async execution and full job lifecycle observability.

Developed an AI-powered Text2SQL system in Python with a conversational chat interface, using RAG-based context retrieval and fine-tuned query generation to let non-technical users query databases without writing a single line of SQL.

Built MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers exposing internal AI components as callable tools, including size chart lookup and automated support reply, enabling AI agents to interact directly with production services.
Implemented a Data Warehouse consolidating data from several business units using Kafka, improving inventory accuracy and cutting manual reporting time.
Developed an internal stress-testing automation tool that reduced test setup from hours to under 5 minutes and let multiple teams run stress tests with proper system resources.

summary: Taught Go to working engineers, from language fundamentals through production deployment.
highlights: Taught Go/Golang fundamentals, REST API best practices, and Microservices development through deployment.

summary: Core API team for a logistics platform, focused on query performance and test coverage.

Increased test coverage from 20% to 60%, significantly reducing production bugs.
Implemented rate limiting and request filtering to mitigate DDoS attacks.

summary: Content delivery at news-media scale: caching, microservice migration and in-house video.

Increased scalability by migrating services from a Node.js monolith to a Go microservice architecture.

Built read-optimized content serving APIs using Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, Redis, and GraphQL.
Mentored 3 interns and led a cross-functional project delivering improvements to the Kumparan platform.
